outcome_summary: The Insights tab removal was implemented across the GUI entry points, route handling, backend wiring, tests, and manifest references. The user-facing navigation and obsolete Insights view code are gone, and the Knowledge view remains as the forward-looking cross-cutting experience.
project_summary: This project removes the Insights global navigation tab and related GUI route, API, test, and manifest references. It leaves the Knowledge experience as the cross-cutting view for project-wide insight discovery and preserves project-level comments access.
